desc: 暖奶油灰详情页，木脚圆形猫狗深窝，十一镜从痛点到收口
name: 猫狗两用木脚圆形深窝款

shots.intent: 首屏用真实居家阳光与出窝瞬间建立情感代入，一秒读懂这是给猫狗睡的高颜值窝
shots.textZone: 顶部中央主标题带，其上一枚焦糖胶囊 kicker 位，其下一枚短副标题位

shots.intent: 在纯色版面上把核心主张压到一眼可读，替代源图里空洞的口号堆叠
shots.textZone: 上部三分之一主标题带，产品下方一行三枚胶囊标签位

shots.intent: 把宠物趴硬地板掉毛的日常摩擦放大成可自我代入的痛点，制造解决需求
shots.textZone: 两栏底端各一枚短胶囊标签位

shots.intent: 用侧面全廓加引线把窝的结构讲清楚，解释它为什么睡着稳、看着简洁
shots.textZone: 左上主标题带，四条引线各连一枚胶囊标签位

shots.intent: 用低角度特写证明口沿、提手位与支脚接合的做工，替掉口头质量承诺
微距直接呈现壳面纹理与内垫缝线张力，用可见材质替代环保与舒适话术
给出最典型的使用时刻，让买家想象自家宠物在窗边窝着晒太阳
用玩耍、休憩、进食三格说明窝在一天里的存在感，扩大场景覆盖
shots.textZone: 三格下方各一枚胶囊标签位

shots.intent: 把小型与大型两档放到同一俯视场里对比，替买家自己判断该选哪一档
shots.textZone: 两档各一枚尺寸引线占位与一行适用短标签位，顶部主标题带

shots.intent: 用干净的参数卡消除最后疑虑，把源图带款号二维码的贴片换成中性信息表
shots.textZone: 右栏五行规格标签与占位值，行距均匀，卡片上方主标题带

shots.intent: 收口用仰视气势把窝拍成主子的一栋小别墅，给一个低摩擦下单动作
shots.textZone: 上半区主标题带与一行副标题位，右下圆角胶囊按钮位

style.backgroundSystem: flat cream-apricot #FBDFBB panels alternating with flat cool light grey #E9EAEA panels, joined by real sunlit living-room screens on a warm off-white base #F4EFE8; one panel treatment per screen, clean white #FFFFFF reserved for the size-comparison and spec screens, never a third background language
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight 2px caramel line icons of one family only, rounded capsule labels in #B0764A with #FFFFFF text, hairline leader lines ending in a small solid dot, and a recurring three-bar caramel rule glyph as the section divider
style.lightingSystem: soft directional window daylight from the left at 5200K filtered by a sheer curtain, mixed with an even 5500K studio fill; low contrast, gentle falloff, controlled highlights only, always a real contact shadow under the product so it reads as resting on its own base
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm minimal pet-home ecommerce detail-page visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cream-apricot panel #FBDFBB, cool light grey panel #E9EAEA, warm off-white room base #F4EFE8, deep charcoal text #2D2D2D and one caramel accent #B0764A; warm daylight tone; modern geometric sans-serif for Chinese and Latin with one headline weight per screen, headline 28-42pt, capsule label 14-18pt, all copy as 「」 placeholders; background system alternating flat cream-apricot and cool light grey panels with real sunlit living-room screens, one panel treatment per screen; soft directional window daylight from the left at 5200K with an even 5500K studio fill, low contrast, gentle falloff and always a real contact shadow under the product; surfaces of loop-pile cream rug, pale oak floor and matte plaster wall; infographic components limited to thin 2px single-weight caramel line icons, rounded capsule labels in #B0764A with #FFFFFF text, hairline leader lines ending in a small solid dot, and a recurring three-bar caramel rule glyph as the section divider; product held at a stable slight 3/4 angle and consistent scale, grounded by its own contact shadow, never floating; 16px corner radius wherever a card is used; 2:3 mobile detail-page slice; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no glossy 3D clip-art arrows, no unfilled placeholder boxes, no QR codes or store badges.
noDrift: no glossy 3D clip-art arrows or stock render graphics
no unfilled white placeholder boxes or leader lines pointing into empty space
no QR codes, membership patches or store promotion overlays
style.presentationRules: the bed keeps one stable slight 3/4 hero angle and a constant scale across screens, always grounded with weight and never floating, its own surface finish and construction reading true to the reference; animals appear cropped or turned away so no individual identity reads; card corners fixed at 16px
style.surfaceSystem: loop-pile cream rug, pale oak floor, matte plaster wall, bare pale tile for the pain-point panel; surfaces stay slightly lived-in and never sterile
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif for both Chinese and Latin, one headline weight per screen; Chinese headline 28-42pt, capsule label 14-18pt, spec row label 16pt, all rendered copy carried as 「」 placeholders, a letter-spaced kicker line used at most once per screen
